content: fig:snliarch, describes the neural network architecture. After each premise and hypothesis is encoded into $S_p$ and $S_h$ , respectively, we have a fusion layer. This layer has no trainable weights and just concatenate each sentence embedding. Following BIBREF17 , we add two more matching methods: the absolute difference $\vert S_p - S_h \vert $ and the element-wise $S_p \odot S_h$ . Finally, in order to learn the pair representation, $S_ph$ is feed into and FC layer with rectified linear unit (ReLU) activation function, which is expressed as $f(x) = \log (1 + e^x)$ . The last softmax layer outputs the probability of each class.
